## Featured Engineering Projects & Production Domains
- Shefware (shefware.com): Enterprise-grade software platform for automated mailbox backup, high-throughput cloud data migration, and disaster recovery across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Exchange. Handled 10M+ items with zero packet loss and 99.98% pipeline uptime.
- OST to PST Online (osttopst.us): Specialized web utility platform for converting Outlook OST storage files into PST formats without requiring local Microsoft Outlook installations, recovering attachments, contacts, and preserving full folder structures.
- Sky States (skystates.us): Premier EdTech and AI learning bootcamp platform headquartered in Seattle, Washington, offering cohort-based and live training in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, DevOps, and Cybersecurity.
- Nexus Platform (Full Stack & Mobile Architecture): Cross-platform React Native and Next.js platform with synchronized offline-first state, sub-80ms global API latency, sharing 85% business logic across iOS, Android, and web.
- Mindspace Arch (DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure): Modern developer dashboard and cloud orchestration platform pairing dark brutalist UI/UX with Kubernetes and Docker automation.
